name: matrix-golf
description: Connect your Matrix Golf account to see what's actually happening in your game: handicap, rounds, scorecards, playing stats, and your golf group's leagues and cups.

interface.longDescription:
See what's actually happening in your game.

Every golfer knows their score. Matrix Golf shows why it was that score. Connect your Matrix Golf account and ask about your own golf in plain words:

- Your handicap index and how many rounds it is based on.
- Your recent rounds, and any scorecard hole by hole, with putts, fairways and greens in regulation when you tracked them.
- Your playing stats over your latest rounds: where you lose shots, how you score on par 3s, 4s and 5s, and whether you are trending up or down.
- Your personal records.
- Your golf group: league standings and cup scoreboards.
- The pars and stroke indexes of any course in the Matrix catalog.

Matrix Golf only reads your own account. It cannot post scores or change anything. You need a Matrix Golf account with rounds recorded in the Matrix Golf app for iPhone, Android, Apple Watch or Wear OS.
defaultPrompt: How did my last round go?
What part of my game is costing me the most shots?
Where do I stand in my group's league?

positive.description: Read the golfer's handicap from their profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_my_profile once and shows the profile card. States the handicap index and says whether it is computed by Matrix Golf from the golfer's rounds or self-reported. Does not recalculate it.
Calls list_rounds and shows the rounds card: course, date, holes played, gross score, score to par and putts for each round, newest first.

positive.description: Open the hole-by-hole scorecard of the latest round.
positive.prompt: Show the scorecard for my most recent round.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_rounds to find the newest round, then get_round with its round_id, and shows the scorecard card with par, strokes and putts for every hole and the front and back nine totals.

positive.description: Analyze strengths and weaknesses from playing stats.
positive.prompt: What part of my game is costing me the most shots?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_playing_stats and shows the stats card. Names the weakest area using the returned figures (for example greens in regulation, three-putts or penalties) and says when a statistic was not tracked instead of treating it as zero.

positive.description: Show the standings of a league in the golfer's group.
positive.prompt: Where do I stand in my group's league?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_groups to find the golfer's group and its league, then get_league_standings with that league_id, and shows the standings card with the golfer's own row marked. States the golfer's position and points.

negative.description: Write request. The plugin is read-only, so it should not act and should say scores are entered in the Matrix Golf app.
negative.prompt: Change my score on hole 3 of my last round to a 4.

negative.description: Another person's private data. The plugin only reads the signed-in golfer's own rounds, so it should not try to fetch someone else's scorecards and should say so.
negative.prompt: Show me every scorecard my friend Marta has ever played.

negative.description: Unrelated request. No Matrix Golf tool applies, so none should be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in St Andrews tomorrow?

es-ES.subtitle: Hándicap, estadísticas, peña
es-ES.description:
Mira lo que de verdad está pasando en tu juego.

Conecta tu cuenta de Matrix Golf y pregunta por tu propio golf: tu hándicap, tus últimas vueltas y cualquier tarjeta hoyo a hoyo, tus estadísticas de juego, tus récords, y las ligas y copas de tu peña.

Matrix Golf solo lee tu cuenta. No puede apuntar resultados ni cambiar nada. Necesitas una cuenta de Matrix Golf con vueltas registradas en la app.
